objectivesText: Purchase a Bundle of Herbs from Nida the herbalist, a Bundle of Ceder Twigs from Nata the enchanting supplier, and Sinew Thread from Mahu the leatherworking supplier and Ceremonial Flint and Tinder from Naal the cooking supplier.
